def factor_regime_adaptive_momentum_reversal(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    momentum = df_copy["close"].pct_change(periods=5)
    reversal = -df_copy["close"].pct_change(periods=5)
    factor = np.where(is_low_vol > 0, reversal, momentum)
    df_copy["factor_regime_adaptive_momentum_reversal"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_regime_adaptive_momentum_reversal"]
description: This factor expresses a regime-dependent fusion of short-term momentum and reversal strategies based on volume state. In low-volume regimes, markets tend to mean-revert, so the signal uses a reversal (negative of 5-day return). In normal or high-volume regimes, momentum persists, so the signal uses the raw 5-day return. The volume regime is determined by classify_volume_regime with a 20-day lookback, providing continuous signals. This captures orthogonal information from volume context to adapt the price signal, improving robustness across market states.
